methodology.economic_information: The Chicago Fed composite summarizes real economic activity across production/income,employment/hours,consumption/housing and sales/orders/inventories. CFNAIMA3 measures three-month average activity relative to historical trend;CFNAIDIFF is the three-month diffusion measure of weighted positive versus negative/neutral contributions. These are related views of one composite,not two independent alpha sources.
methodology.primary_interpretation: The publisher associates negative CFNAI values with below-average growth. Following expansion,it historically associates CFNAIMA3 below-0.70 with increased recession likelihood. Expansion periods have historically been associated with CFNAIDIFF above-0.35. These conditional historical interpretations are not unconditional recession labels,predictive trading laws or evidence of incremental portfolio returns.

methodology.availability: Select only a completed observation month actually present in its earlier ALFREDsnapshot. The two-NYSE-session buffer applies to the snapshot,not a fabricated release on the month label. ALFREDdaily as-of archives still do not authenticate every original intraday first-publication time or the complete underlying component/weight vintages.

Any missing/stale query blocks readiness;do not relax the limit,drop required months,fill/interpolate,or silently create a standby portfolio.
